doom.title: DOOM — sealed runnable package (doom.wasm + doom1.wad)
doom.head: 350d_DUtbVom1UtV23xl7BGMpEkVGo0BI62N_aLBIks
doom.how: 1h before expiry the keeper re-copies every section (same keys, fresh nonces → new blob IDs) and updates the manifest. Same key keeps working — the film never blinks.

gertie.title: Gertie the Dinosaur (1914)
gertie.head: JWHt8Yv4OLICEv-K46JzTTDQ6j84u3F5VlFnUgjpaH0
gertie.expires: head re-copied every ~5 min (demo) — always fresh; each copy stored 5 epochs
gertie.how: Same key, fresh nonce → new blob ID → manifest updated, every ~5 min. The player follows the manifest with the same KEY0 — kill any blob and the film keeps living.
